## Purpose
Card that lists recent blog posts. It picks a source from the blog config (Medium or dev.to via `@arifszn/blog-js`, otherwise a built-in fallback list) and renders up to `blog.limit` articles with thumbnail, description and category tags.

## Key concepts
- `BlogCard` props: `loading`, `blog` (`SanitizedBlog` from [[src-interfaces]]) and optional `googleAnalyticsId`.
- Source selection in `useEffect`: `medium` calls `getMediumPost`, `dev` calls `getDevPost`, anything else uses `wpBlogs`.
- `wpBlogs` in `fallback-list.tsx`: hard-coded array of posts (WordPress and Medium links, `publishedAt` dates) used when no remote source is configured.
- Clicking an article opens it in a new tab and fires a `Click Blog Post` event via `ga` from [[src-utils]] when `googleAnalyticsId` is set. Thumbnails use [[src-components-lazy-image]].

## Gotchas
- Fetch promises have no `.catch`, so a failed Medium/dev request leaves `articles` empty and shows 'No recent post'.
- `renderArticles` also indexes `article.categories` directly, so every article needs a `categories` array.
- Fallback posts are static data: they must be edited by hand in `fallback-list.tsx`.
